title: WhatsApp chat
stale: Could not refresh. The visible history is preserved.
search: Search by name or phone number
empty: No messages have arrived at this WhatsApp yet.
select: Choose a conversation to view messages and reply.
readFailed: Could not save your reading position.
reuse: Use this text in the draft

mode.manualDescription: Manual replies will be enabled in this conversation. Access codes requested from the website will keep working.
mode.uncertain: Could not confirm the change. Refresh the chat and check its mode before trying again.

send.label: Reply to customer
send.validation: Enter a message of up to 4096 characters.
send.uncertain: Could not confirm whether the request was saved. Check its outcome before repeating it.
send.checkFailed: Could not check the request. Your draft is still kept on this screen.
send.notStored: The request is not saved yet. You may repeat the same request; the system prevents duplicates.
send.forbidden: You no longer have permission for this action.
send.readOnly: You can view the chat. Replying requires the send permission.
send.windowClosed: More than 24 hours have passed since the customer’s last message. Template sending will be added later.
send.noPhone: WhatsApp did not provide a phone number we can reply to.
send.pending: This conversation has a pending or unconfirmed delivery request.

review.description: Check WhatsApp on the phone: this message may have been sent. It will not be automatically repeated.
review.title: Confirm delivery review
review.confirmDescription: This action enables new replies. It does not send this message again or mark it delivered. Confirm only after checking what arrived on the phone.
review.uncertain: Could not confirm the review. Refresh the chat and check the delivery state before trying again.

leave.title: Leave with unsent replies?
leave.description: Drafts are kept when switching conversations but are lost when leaving this screen.

forms.title: Send a form to {{name}}
forms.description: They receive a WhatsApp message with an “Open form” button. What they complete is saved as a form response.
forms.loadFailed: We could not load the forms.
forms.language: They receive it in {{language}}, the language of their account.
forms.messageHelp: This appears above the “{{cta}}” button. The final button inside the form is different: “{{submitLabel}}”.
forms.messageRequiredInfo: The message is required: WhatsApp does not send the button alone.
forms.required: Enter the message accompanying the form.
forms.chooseRequired: Choose the form you want to send.
forms.deadline: You can send it until {{deadline}}, 24 hours after their last message.
forms.uncertain: We could not confirm whether the request was saved. Check its status before repeating it.
forms.sendFailed: The send request could not be saved.
forms.recipientChanged: The linked account or its language changed. Close the dialog, refresh the chat and review the recipient before sending.
forms.formUnavailable: The selected form is no longer available. Choose another one.
forms.unavailable: We could not check whether they can receive forms.
forms.noLinkedAccount: The number must be linked to an account before sending a form.
forms.inactiveAccount: The linked account is inactive and cannot complete forms.
forms.noEligibleForms: There are no published forms they can complete.
forms.failed: The form did not reach the recipient. You can send a new one using “Send form”.
forms.waitingHint: Wait {{seconds}} seconds before checking or sending again.

reply.valuesUnavailable: The answers could not be displayed.
reply.label: Form reply
reply.pending: A form reply arrived. We are saving it…
reply.rejected: We could not save the form reply. You can write to them or send it again.
reply.unrecognized: A form reply arrived that could not be matched to a send. It was not saved.
reply.noPermission: You do not have permission to view this form’s answers.
reply.revoked: You no longer have permission to view these answers.
reply.messageRemoved: The WhatsApp message is no longer available. The reply remains saved.
reply.catalogInactive: {{label}}: an option was deactivated. The response was not saved.
reply.downloading: We received the form. We are downloading the files from WhatsApp and saving the reply.
reply.retryingFiles: We are trying to download the files again. No action is needed.
reply.filesUnavailable: We could not download the files from WhatsApp. The reply was not saved.
reply.filesRejected: A file does not meet the allowed type, size or content. The reply was not saved.
reply.downloadingCount_one: Received {{count}} file. Downloading it from WhatsApp and saving the response.
reply.downloadingCount_other: Received {{count}} files. Downloading them from WhatsApp and saving the response.
reply.filesRejectedQuestion: Could not save the file for “{{label}}”. The response was not saved.
reply.filesResendHint: You can send the form again.

catalogs.loadFailed: The catalog options could not be loaded.
catalogs.unavailable: {{label}}: the catalog is unavailable. Notify its administrator.
catalogs.tooLarge: {{label}}: exceeds the 200 options supported by WhatsApp. Adjust the catalog before sending.
catalogs.empty: {{label}}: has no options and the question is required.
catalogs.invalidOption_one: {{label}}: {{count}} option in {{catalog}} does not fit in WhatsApp. Review its text and detail.
catalogs.invalidOption_other: {{label}}: {{count}} options in {{catalog}} do not fit in WhatsApp. Review their text and details.
